play.help:
Commands:
  buy <machine#> <count> [used] [site#]  e.g. "buy 1 2" or "buy 3 1 used 2" (site 1 if left out)
  sell <batch#> <count>                  sell at the used price
  repair <batch#>                        fix broken units
  hodl <0-100> [btc|eth]                 % of mined coins to keep instead of selling (both coins if left out)
  scout <tier>                           e.g. "scout warehouse" (1 Bandwidth)
  build <offer#> or build <tier>         e.g. "build 1" or "build small_unit" (1 Bandwidth)
  build <offer#> [loan] [fixed|index]    Texas: phase 1 (20 MW) and its power contract; loan = 60% on a construction loan (from 2020Q3, needs Series A)
  phase <site#> [loan]                   start Texas's next 20 MW phase (1 Bandwidth, 2 quarters)
  upgrade <site#>                        fix an undersized transformer: $150K, 1 Bandwidth, ready next quarter
  raise ff                               friends & family: +$40K for 10% (2 Bandwidth, until 2018Q2)
  raise seed                             seed investors: +$1.5M for 20% (2 Bandwidth, 2017Q4–2019Q4, needs a powered 100 kW site)
  raise a                                Series A: +$8M for 20% (2 Bandwidth, 2019Q1–2021Q2, needs 1 MW powered across your sites)
  raise ipo                              IPO / SPAC: +$150M for 15% (3 Bandwidth, 2021, needs 20 MW and $3M quarterly EBITDA)
  pitch seed|a                           pitch the round for a higher valuation instead (2 Bandwidth, lost if no deal), then:
  counter <$M> · accept · walk           e.g. "counter 6.6" (pre-money valuation in $ millions)
  leave <site#>                          break a site's lease: 1 month's rent, its machines are sold
  loan <amount>                          borrow against your machines, e.g. "loan 5000" (1 Bandwidth)
  repay [construction]                   pay the equipment (or construction) loan off early
  cloan <btc|eth> <amount>               pledge treasury coins and borrow, e.g. "cloan eth 5000" (1 Bandwidth, 2018Q1–2022Q2)
  crepay                                 repay the crypto loan and get the coins back
  renew <site#> [fixed|index]            accept a due power contract renewal's opening offer (0 Bandwidth)
  negotiate <site#> [4|8] [fixed|index]  negotiate a due renewal instead (2 Bandwidth), then:
  counter <cents> · accept · walk        e.g. "counter 5.2" (price in ¢/kWh)
  hire <1-5> · fire <1-5>                1 Ops Manager, 2 Trader, 3 BD Lead, 4 Ex-Utility Exec, 5 Chief of Staff (hire: 1 Bandwidth + a quarter's salary in cash)
  read                                   read the market: a BTC/ETH hint for this quarter (1 Bandwidth, 0 with the Trader)
  talk <site#>                           talk to the neighbours there: cash + 1 Bandwidth, lowers Heat
  mitigate <site#>                       noise mitigation there: base Heat -10 for good (once per site)
  sellcoins <btc|eth> <1-100>            sell that % of a coin in the treasury, e.g. "sellcoins eth 50" (1 Bandwidth)
  bid <amount> [site#]                   sealed bid for this quarter's distressed auction lot (2 Bandwidth)
  host <site#> <kW>                      Act II: rent free power at a site to other miners, $0.1M per MW, live next quarter (1 Bandwidth)
  unhost <#>                             end a hosting contract (a quarter of fees mid-term)
  project <site#> <kW> shell|cloud|pilot [h100|h200|b200]  Act II: open an AI project on free MW (1 Bandwidth)
  sign <project#> <offer#>               sign a tenant offer for a shell (0 Bandwidth)
  spot <project#> · fund <project#>      a cloud sells on spot · fund the project with own cash
  start <project#>                       start the build: pays the capex (1 Bandwidth)
  cancel <project#> · sellproject <#>    drop a proposed project · sell a live shell at the cap rate (2 Bandwidth)
  sellgpus <project#>                    sell a live cloud's or pilot's GPUs at their resale value; it ends (1 Bandwidth)
  debt <project#> project|ddtl [off]     use project debt (tenant BBB+) or a GPU-backed DDTL (GPU contract) for the build
  backstop <project#>                    a big-tech backstop on a BB-or-lower tenant's lease: warrants 3–6% (2025Q3+, 2 Bandwidth)
  jv <project#> <50-80>                  a JV partner funds and takes that % of a 100 MW+ project (2025Q1+, 2 Bandwidth)
  equity <8-20>                          sell that % of the company at your last valuation (2 Bandwidth)
  end                                   start the live quarter
  look                                   show the full Plan screen again
  help · quit

ui.loan.rating_note: Priced on your credit rating ({rating}): SOFR plus the spread for that band, {apr} a year, up to {ltv} of the collateral. A better rating when you borrow means a cheaper, bigger loan.
ui.loan.max: Lenders go up to {ltv} of that
ui.loan.payment: About {value} a quarter to start with (principal plus interest), for {quarters} quarters.
ui.plan.crypto_loan_offer: Crypto-backed loan · {ltv} of coin value at {apr}
ui.cloan.title: Crypto-backed loan
ui.cloan.note: Pledge coins from your treasury and borrow up to {ltv} of their value, at {apr} a year (paid weekly). Repay whenever you like to get the coins back. If the coin's price falls, the loan-to-value (LTV) rises: at {call} the lender makes a margin call, at {liquidation} it sells your coins.
ui.cloan.danger: Margin call if {coin} falls to {call} (now {price}); forced sale at {liquidation}.
ui.hires.title: People
ui.hires.note: Hiring costs {bw} Bandwidth and needs a quarter's salary in cash. Salaries are paid weekly and count in EBITDA. Letting someone go is free in Bandwidth but costs a quarter's salary, and you can't rehire them the same quarter.
ui.margin_warning.title: Your Trader flags the crypto loan
ui.margin_warning.body: Your {coin} loan ({balance}) is at {ltv} LTV. A margin call comes at 70%. Repay it now, or carry on and watch the price.
ui.community.title: Neighbours and noise
ui.community.note: Talking to the neighbours ({bw} Bandwidth) buys goodwill: grievance {grievance}, at most once per site per quarter. Noise mitigation ({mbw} Bandwidth) lowers a site's base Heat by {base} for good, once per site.
ui.complaint.title: The neighbours are complaining about the {tier}
ui.complaint.body: Fans at night, trucks at dawn, a power bill that went up. Heat at the {tier} is {heat}. Settle it, fix the noise for good, or let it build.
ui.complaint.source: Hood County TX and upstate NY noise disputes. One complaint a quarter at most, from Heat {at}.
ui.auction.title: Distressed auction
ui.auction.note: A failed miner's machines, sold as one lot: {value} at the used price. Minimum bid {reserve}. Needs {power} of free space at one site.
ui.auction.profit: Each earns {value}/day at the {tier} at today's prices.
ui.auction.rules: One bid only. The highest bid wins and pays what it bid; a tie goes to the rival. Win or lose, the bid costs the Bandwidth. Used machines arrive at once and earn from next quarter.
ui.signals.title: Signals
ui.signals.headline: Headline · {quarter}
ui.signals.read_market: Read the market ({bw} Bandwidth) hints whether BTC and ETH rise or fall more than {up} this quarter.
ui.read.result: Your read for this quarter: {btc} · {eth} (▲ ▼ = a move of more than {pct}).
ui.read.accuracy: Reads are right about {pct} of the time, and never off by more than one step.
read_flavour.up: Desks are whispering about fresh money coming in.
read_flavour.flat: The chatter is noncommittal: nobody wants to call it.
read_flavour.down: Lenders are getting nervous, and so are the forums.
error.market_read_done: You've already read the market this quarter.
ui.buy.title: Buy machines
ui.buy.profit_note: Profit per unit per day at this week's prices, on {site} power. Used machines break down more often.
ui.fleet_dialog.title: Your machines
ui.fleet_dialog.note: Machines sell at the used price. Broken ones go first, for the used price minus the repair cost.
ui.leave.title: Leave the {tier}?
ui.leave.note: Breaking the lease costs one month of rent. Rent stops from this quarter. It costs no Bandwidth.
ui.leave.machines: Sell {n} machine(s) there at the used price
ui.offers.title: Site offers
ui.offers.note: Each offer hides one flaw. You find out what it is when you build.
ui.offers.contract: Power contract for the new site:
ui.offers.financed_hint: Construction loan: borrow {loan} (60% of the cost, 11% a year, 8 quarters) and pay {cash} now.
ui.live.hodl_note: Selling {btc} of mined BTC and {eth} of mined ETH as they come in.
ui.uri.title: A deep freeze is coming to Texas
ui.uri.body: Week {week}: the grid is short of power and prices are about to hit the cap. Honour your curtailment deal: take the Texas site's {mw} offline and collect {credit} in credits. Or keep mining: an index contract then pays {price}/MWh on its whole contracted load for the week, even if the machines switch off. A fixed contract is unaffected.
ui.uri.effect_mine: Storm charge {charge} on index contracts · fixed contracts mine as usual (about {forgone}) · grievance {grievance}
ui.uri.source: Winter Storm Uri, Feb 2021: ERCOT prices sat at the $9,000/MWh cap for days. Index contracts earn 1.5× curtailment credits.
ui.grid.title: The Texas grid asks you to switch off
ui.grid.body: A heat wave is straining the grid. Take the Texas site's {mw} offline for week {week} and the grid pays {credit} in credits. Mining that week would earn about {forgone}.
ui.grid.effect_curtail: {credit} in credits · gives up about {forgone} of mining, and saves the power
ui.grid.effect_mine: Earns about {forgone} · no credits · grievance {grievance} at the Texas site
ui.grid.source: Credits pay the bigger of $15K per MW or 1.25× the mining revenue given up (Texas demand response).
ui.margin.title: Your lender wants more collateral
ui.margin.body: {coin} fell and your loan of {balance} is now {ltv} of the pledged coins' value. Bring it back to {target} this week, or the lender sells your coins at {liquidation}.
ui.margin.effect_default: Lose {coins} ({value}) · {balance} written off · no loans for {quarters} quarters
play.negotiation: The utility offers {offer}/kWh. Round {round} of {rounds}: counter <cents>, accept or walk.
play.pitch: The investor offers a {offerUsd} pre-money valuation. Round {round} of {rounds}: counter <$M>, accept or walk.
play.pitch_final: The investor's last offer: a {offerUsd} pre-money valuation. Accept or walk.
play.negotiation_final: The utility's last offer: {offer}/kWh. Accept or walk.
play.margin_warning: Your Trader flags the {coin} loan ({balanceUsd}): LTV {ltvPct}. A margin call comes at 70%.
play.margin_call: ⚠ MARGIN CALL: your {coin} loan of {balanceUsd} is at {ltvPct} LTV. Bring it back to 50% now, or default.
ui.alert.body: Your treasury holds {holdings}, worth {value} at this week's price. Take some money off the table, or ride it?
ui.alert.source: Alerts fire when a coin moves {threshold} or more in a week, at most {max} a quarter.
ui.report.label: Quarter report · Turn {turn} of {turns}
ui.report.valuation_sub: run-rate EBITDA × era multiple + cash + treasury − debt
ui.report.cash_line: Cash: start {start} + coin sales {sales} − power {power} − rent {rent} = end {end}.
ui.report.cash_line_loan: Cash: start {start} + coin sales {sales} − power {power} − rent {rent} − loan payments {loan} = end {end}.
ui.report.grid_line: Includes {credits} of grid credits for curtailing the Texas site.
ui.report.hosting_line: Includes {fees} of hosting fees from other miners' machines (the power they used is in the power cost).
ui.report.reservation_line: Power cost includes {usd} of reservation charges: idle and under-construction megawatts pay 25% of full-load power to keep their grid connection.
ui.report.storm_line: Winter Storm Uri: storm power charge {usd} (included in power).
ui.report.debt_line: Still owed on the equipment loan: {debt} (interest this quarter: {interest}).
hire_effect.ops_manager: Machine failures halved on every site.
hire_effect.trader: Read the market is free, and an alert pauses the quarter when your crypto loan's LTV reaches 65%, before a margin call.
hire_effect.bd_lead: Scouting finds one more offer and shows each offer's hidden flaw. Investors go about 5% higher in pitches.
hire_effect.ex_utility: Site builds take a quarter less (never under 1 quarter). Utilities give about 5% more ground in power negotiations.
hire_effect.chief_of_staff: +1 Bandwidth every quarter, from next quarter (maximum 6).
error.rehire_same_quarter: You let the {hire} go this quarter: you can rehire next quarter.
error.hire_needs_cash: Hiring the {hire} needs a quarter's salary in cash ({neededUsd}).
ui.merge.label: 15 September 2022
ui.merge.title: The Merge
ui.merge.body: Ethereum switches to proof-of-stake. From today, GPU mining pays nothing. What does your company become?
ui.merge.resale: worth {value} used, into a flooded market
ui.wave.title: A failure wave at the {tier}
ui.wave.body: {units} machines at the {tier} went down at once: a bad batch of PSUs, dust, a hot week. They stay off until they're repaired.
ui.wave.effect_rush: {cash} (rush repair, {mult} the usual price) · back next week
ui.wave.effect_degraded: No cost now · they stay off until you repair them in the Plan phase
log.failure_wave_repaired: Failure wave at the {tier}: {units} units broke; rush-repaired for {costUsd}.
log.failure_wave_degraded: Failure wave at the {tier}: {units} units broke and stay off until repaired.
log.failure_wave_silent: Failure wave at the {tier}: {units} units broke (no time to deal with it this quarter).
play.failure_wave: FAILURE WAVE at the {tier}: {units} units broke. Rush repair costs {rushUsd}.
ui.merge.no_sites: You have no site beyond the garage.
merge_choice.sell_gpus_keep_btc: Sell the GPUs, go all-in on bitcoin
log.event_lawyer_won: The lawyers won: the moratorium at the {tier} is lifted for 4 quarters.
log.event_lawyer_lost: The lawyers lost: the moratorium at the {tier} stands.
log.event_scam_real: The half-price seller was real: used machines are half price next Plan phase.
log.event_scam_lost: The seller vanished with your {depositUsd} deposit.
error.gpus_sold_out: New GPU rigs are sold out this quarter (you chose to wait for the restock).

log.head_start.gpu_cloud: Head start: {count} GPU rigs now rent out as a small GPU cloud. You start with GPU know-how 1.
log.head_start.hosting: Head start: sold {count} GPU rigs for {valueUsd} and turned {hostedKw} of GPU halls into hosting for {costUsd}.

ui.chapter.body: Five years from a garage to the Merge. Here's how your company did.

ui.hosting.title: Hosting
ui.hosting.note: Rent energized power you aren't using to other miners. They pay an all-in rate per kWh their machines use; you pay the power. Converting costs {cost} per MW and {bw} Bandwidth; clients move in next quarter, on {term}-quarter terms that renew at the then-current rate. Ending mid-term costs a quarter of fees.
ui.hosting.relet: {value} ready to re-let: free, clients move in at once
ui.hosting.live: {kw} at the {tier}: {rate} until {quarter} · about {fees} a quarter in fees
ui.act2_intro.label: Act II · The Pivot and the Boom
ui.act2_intro.title: Q4 2022. Ethereum no longer pays miners. ChatGPT launches next month.
ui.act2_intro.body: Four years, 2022 to 2026: turn your energized megawatts into AI capacity, or ride bitcoin through the halving. Your company carries over as it is.
ui.act2_intro.lifeline_title: A bankrupt miner's site, going cheap
ui.act2_intro.lifeline_body: A rival just filed Chapter 11. Its {siteKw} site goes to auction for {priceUsd} with the lights still on. A bridge lender offers {loanUsd} at {aprPct} for {quarters} quarters: enough for the site, leaving you {cashUsd} in cash. Interest every week, the whole loan due at the end.
ui.act2_intro.lifeline_take: Bid with the bridge loan and begin Act II →
ui.act2_intro.head_start.sell_gpus_keep_: Sold {count} GPU rigs for {valueUsd}. Lean operations: mining power costs {leanPct} less for {leanQuarters} quarters. Handicap: your first AI project builds a quarter longer, and you have no GPU know-how until your first cluster is live.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.gpu_cloud: {count} GPU rigs rent out as a small GPU cloud (${usdHr} a GPU-hour at {utilPct} use). GPU know-how 1: the first AI tenants call from {tenantsFrom} (others wait until {tenantsLater}), and your first cluster builds a quarter faster. Handicap: the old cards barely earn more than their power.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.hosting: Sold {count} GPU rigs for {valueUsd} and turned {hostedKw} of GPU halls into hosting for {costUsd}: other miners pay {rateCents}¢/kWh all-in for {termQuarters} quarters. Those sites are shell-ready: an AI shell there costs {discountPct} less and builds a quarter faster. Handicap: ending hosting early costs a quarter of fees.
ui.act2_intro.head_start.hold_and_wait: Your GPU rigs are switched off and your sites stay energized, ready for whatever comes next. Handicap: idle megawatts still cost power and rent.
